title: Object Storage: portfolio discount fraction
content:
Object Storage portfolio discount fraction is defined as follows: Discount fraction when the portfolio threshold is met; decimal.

| Contract tier | Portfolio discount fraction |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB | portfolio discount fraction: 0.025 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 10 TB | portfolio discount fraction: 0.03 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 25 TB | portfolio discount fraction: 0.035 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 50 TB | portfolio discount fraction: 0.04 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 100 TB | portfolio discount fraction: 0.045 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 250 TB | portfolio discount fraction: 0.05 |

## Tier reference

For Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB, the portfolio discount fraction entry is 0.025.
